days.title: Northern Coastal Sights
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: giardino Botanico litoraneo di Porto Caleri
stops.detail: the coastal Botanical Garden of Porto Caleri in the locality of Porto Caleri in Rosolina Mare.

stops.name: Porto Caleri
stops.detail: Also noteworthy are cervids such as the fallow deer present on the island of Albarella which cross over into the valleys and into Porto Caleri and mustelids (such as the weasel), predators that occupy an important control function on bird and rodent populations.

days.title: Fossil Dunes and Pine Forests
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: dune fossili
stops.detail: The territory is an alternation of different environments that follow one another from the mainland to the sea: after the countryside we find the fossil dunes, which can be visited and correspond to the ancient coastlines.

stops.name: pinete di Porto Viro
stops.detail: Also interesting is the presence of truffles, especially in correspondence with the fossil dune ridges that pass through the pine forests of Porto Viro.
